generation.reason: No local video-generation weights or enabled Riwaq cloud video adapter have been configured and validated. A connected Runway chat plugin is not an application API credential.
required_configuration: Chosen current model and verified operation limits
Application API credentials in OS keyring
Hybrid mode and exact input/upload consent
Per-job quoted cost ceiling and explicit spending approval
Task status/cancellation and verified bounded output download

arabic_tts.reason: No installed and validated Arabic synthesis engine/voice is selected. English Windows voices do not establish Arabic narration support. User-provided narration remains separate.
required_configuration: Pinned local engine with license notices
Arabic voice weights/config and exact hashes
Voice training-chain rights review, distinct from engine license
Local Arabic pronunciation/listening evaluation and timing test

capabilities.description: Trim, reorder, letterbox and compose existing project media; this is not AI video generation.
Deterministic camera motion over an existing image; does not synthesize new scene motion.
Explicit user-provided narration, music or effect tracks; no speech generation.
Literal independent text layers rendered by local Chromium/IBM Plex and burned into timed frames. Geometry and source checks; not a guarantee of all-language readability.
H264 yuv420p with optional AAC, checked fast-start and complete decode; 24/30fps in supported landscape/portrait presets.
SRT/WebVTT with explicit manual cue times. No automatic translation, speech alignment or certified behavior across external players.
Only direct cuts are implemented; timing does not include transition overlaps.
